# `fintech_card_payment_has_merchant`

> Card payments must carry a merchant category code (MCC) for AML screening.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_fintech__transactions` (`fintech_silver.slv_fintech__transactions`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `txn_type <> 'card_payment' or merchant_category is not null`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_card_payment_has_merchant`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`card_payment_without_merchant`**: card payments missing their merchant category.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=fintech SCENARIO=card_payment_without_merchant BATCH=2026-10-20_card_payment_without_merchant
make pipeline DOMAIN=fintech BATCH=2026-10-20_card_payment_without_merchant
```
